## Go nesting

- Add Revive v1.16.0 with `max-control-nesting` configured to allow at most three levels.
- Include `revive.toml` in the example configuration. Copy it into consuming repositories when enabling the `revive` hook.
- Follow Revive's nesting semantics: `else if` increases depth; `range` loops do not. Add passing and failing fixtures for this policy.
